title: Paloma Business Batch-Operations Reduction per Extra Seat
content:
Extra seats on a Paloma Business account carry a batch-operations reduction per seat decided by the payouts submitted by batch file in the three months before the day the charge is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day. Each payout line submitted in a batch file counts as one payout.

| Payouts submitted by batch file in the window | Batch-operations reduction per seat |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 2.00 USD |
| 1 to 9 | 1.00 USD |
| None | None |

As a clause: 10 or more batch-file payouts earn a batch-operations reduction of 2.00 USD per seat; 1 to 9 earn 1.00 USD per seat; none earns none.

The batch-operations reduction is taken off the plan's extra seat fee for each seat charged; the per-seat fee is never below 0.00.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- One batch file of 250 payout lines in the window: 250 batch-file payouts, 2.00 USD per seat.
- Payouts submitted only on the web in the window: no batch-operations reduction.
- 9 batch-file payouts: 1.00 USD per seat; 10: 2.00 USD per seat.
